bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
branch="fix/video-chat-two-topic-pinned-doorways-20261123"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$branch"
head="$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)"
test "$head" = "ff6a2059d7110eafc137ad7bdd73990e9d39c7dd"
worktree="$PWD/.worktrees/video-two-topic-doorway-20261123"
if test ! -d "$worktree"; then
 mkdir -p "$PWD/.worktrees"
 git worktree add --detach "$worktree" "$head"
fi
test "$(git -C "$worktree" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$head"
test -z "$(git -C "$worktree" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
docker build --progress=plain -t gace-gaybbs-video-doorway-repair:20261123 -f "$worktree/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" "$worktree"
container="$(docker create gace-gaybbs-video-doorway-repair:20261123)"
trap 'docker rm "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
docker cp "$container:/app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs" "$worktree/.worktreescript.mjs"
docker cp "$worktree/.worktreescript.mjs" deploy-gaybbs-1:/app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs
rm "$worktree/.worktreescript.mjs"
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs
echo VIDEO_TOPIC_PREFLIGHT=PASS
